pages.text: $(d)Viral Agents$() are the final crafting potion of the mod. They are used to craft $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/negative)negative Genes$(/l), which are generally just any Gene that's harmful.$(br2)Negative Genes are $(9)always lost on death$(), regardless of config setting. Additionally, there's a config to prevent players from even being able to $(o)get$() negative Genes in the first place.
Virus Cultivation recipes can be crafted in the Brewing Stand or in either Incubator.
